summary.text: James Gruber is the Democratic state representative for Cheshire 16, in office since December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election in Cheshire 9, where he faces incumbent Republican Richard Nalevanko. He is a professor by career.

paragraphs.text: James Gruber lives in Alstead, New Hampshire, and earned graduate degrees from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Harvard University and a doctoral degree from the University of Zagreb, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a professor.
Gruber won the 2024 general election in Cheshire 16, defeating Bob Willis, and succeeded Joe Schapiro.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for Cheshire 9 on September 8, 2026.
